tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg

phrin las myur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye/ rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi sgo nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba la gnyis/ sgrib sbyong du bya ba dang*/ phung po sbyang ba'o// dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum mo// sbyor ba'i chos la sngar ma sbyangs pa'i sa ru ni sa chog zhi khro'i dbang phreng nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing*/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang dang*/ ba lang gi lhas sogs na ni mi dgos so// de ltar gang du bya ba'i gnas su sa stegs mda' gang sor bzhi pa ngos legs par byas par thig chen brgyad btab pa'i lte ba nas bzung thab khung khru gang ba zlum por bskor ba'i lte bar/ rgyas par na dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs dang*/ bsdus par na lte ba'i lha gnas rnams zhi khro'i mdun bskyed ltar byas pa'i thab khung gi phyir kha khyer dang*/ mchu sor mo bzhi bzhi bskor ba'i kha khyer la rdo rje dkar po'i phreng ba dang*/ mchur padma phyed pa'i dbyibs dkar po bcu drug phyir 'phyang ba/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dang bcas pa rdul tshon gyis legs par bris pa zhal khebs dang ldan pa'i kha khyer gyi steng du/ dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci ba'am/ tsandan dkar po'am/ shug pa sogs sngar las ma byas shing ma rul ba 'bu srin gyis ma zos pa/ dri bzang dang*/ 'o ma/ mar khus sbags pa rlan dang bral ba rnams dbyibs zlum zhing*/ dpangs khru gang brtsegs pa'i nang du shing skam gyis bkang ba'i dbus sam shar lhor me tshang bca'/ de lta bu'i phyir dri bzang 'o ma sa dkar dang bsres pas zla ba ltar dkar bar byug /rang nyid shar du phyogs pas 'jam zhing 'bol ba'i gdan la padma'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa'i g.yas phyogs nas/ yam shing mar khu til yungs kar// zas mchog ku sha durba nas// gro 'bras sran sogs 'bras bu rnams// zhes pa'i sdom gyi go rim ltar/

tsandan dkar po'am/ bal dkar gyi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'i shun pa dang lo ma me tog 'bras bur ldan pa rlan dang bcas pa sor bcu gnyis sam/ bcu bzhi 'am/ khru phyed pa/ sboms su srin mdzub bam mthe'u chung gi tshad ldan/ rtse mo padma'i dbyibs can 'o ma dang sbrang rtsi/ rtsa ba mar khu/ sked par a ru ra dang*/ dri bzang*/ sa dkar dang bcas pas sbags pa/ ba'i mar kha tsha rul sungs med pa'i mar khu/ til nag /yungs kar/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi zas mchog /ku sha dang dūrba rgya bod gang rung sngo ljang rtsa rtse 'dab ma ma grug pa/ gro/ 'bras dkar/ sran ma/ so ba/ shing tog sna tshogs pa/ de'ang 'bru rnams rul sungs 'bu zos ma yin zhing ma grug sa rdo phub sogs med pa ma btsos pa dang*/ so ba shun dang ma bral ba/ gzhan rnams shun pa med pa/ kun kyang dri bzang dang 'o mas sbags pa/ g.yon phyogs su/ dung ngam nya phyis kyi snod du/ nas/ 'o ma/ me tog dkar po/ ku sha/ til dkar/ 'bras yos/ ga pur sogs dri dkar po rnams sbyar ba'i mchod yon/ dri dkar po'i chu'i zhal bsil/ dri bzang dang me tog sna tshogs pas sbags pa'i zhabs bsil te/ chu gsum po so so'i mdun du bzed zhal/ de rnams la gu gul gyis bdug cing*/ gtso bo'i las sngags kyi mthar swā hā btags pas lan bdun sogs sngags pa dang*/ de'i mdun du pad dkar dang tsampaka'i me tog /spos dkar dang sihla tsandan dkar po sogs kyi bdug spos/ ga pur la sogs pa'i dri chab/ mar dkar rul sungs med pa dri bzang gis sbags pa'i mar me/ spra tshil dang thang chu dkar po yang sbyor/ mchan/ dri sna tshogs pa dung zhal du bstsal ba'i dri chab/ 'bras chen gyi phye ma dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i lha bshos/ yang rgyu lha bshos lta bu'i 'jig 'das gnyis la gtor ma re re dang gos zung dkar po re re rnams bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun nam g.yas su rdor dril/ rlung g.yab/

so rtsi/ so rtsi'i rdzas snying zho sha a ru ra sgog skya ga pur mkhal ma zho sha ge sar rnams sbrang dang sbyar ro// mchan/ ku sha/ dgang blugs/ las bum la sogs pa'i nye bar spyod pa rnams bshams shing*/ gzhan yang mthong rgyud ltar bya ba ni sbyor ba'i chos so// bdag mdun bum bskyed la nye bar mkho ba rnams kyang chog gzhung ltar bkod legs par dgram mo// mchan// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha dang*/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// dang po ni/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐ gis rdo rje gsor/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭa aḥs dril bu gsil/ oṃ badzra dzi hwas lce dang*/ hūm̐ āḥs lag pa byin gyis brlabs la/ me lha'i mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar lha rnams dgyes pa bskyed nus par gyur/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra satkā raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gandhe/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapad/ sbyar bas byin gyis brlabs/ dge 'dun gyi tshang mang ngam/ bram ze'i rgyun bzhag gi me las sngags kyis bsangs la sbar bas bud shing dang 'dra ba'i shing dang ku sha'i chun po gtsang zhing skam pa lhan cig tu sbar la/ las sngags kyis bsangs pa me tshang du bcug la/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod cing rlung g.yab kyis sbar la/ las sngags bdun brjod cing mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis me gso/ ku sha ring thung 'tsham pa'i chun po gnyis gnyis rtse mo bshibs te rang gi g.yon ngos nas g.yas skor du rtse mo phyogs bzhir blta zhing snga ma'i rtsa ba phyi ma'i rtse mos non pa kha khyer gyi steng du bkram zhing*/

oṃ badzra satwa āḥ bdun dang*/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*| |bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi zhing bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā/ oṃ badzra satwa āḥ zhes dgram/ che ba gcig thab steng du g.yogs/ thab dang me lha bskyed pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas hrīḥ yig 'od 'bar ba 'phros pas mdun du hūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po/ kha khyer rdo rje dang mchu la padma dkar pos spras pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la raṃ yig dkar po las skyes pa'i me lha shel ltar dkar zhing 'tsher ba/ zhal gcig /phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis mi 'jigs pa dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis rin po che'i dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ sma ra dang gsus pa 'phyang zhing ral ba'i cod pan can/ drang srong gi cha byad la sgeg cing sha rgyas pa/ rnam par shes pa'i 'od phreng spro zhing zhi ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rigs bdag gis spyi bor mtshan pa/ ra skyes dkar po'i khri la g.yon brkyang gis bsgyings pa/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i thugs kar me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i sa bon gyis mtshan par gyur par bsam/ spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ ṭakki dzaḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod rgyal spros te shar lho nas ye shes kyi me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsam/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa mi 'jigs pa'i rgya las srin lag mthe bong gi rtsar g.yob cing g.yon dril bu gsil bas/ oṃ/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog

/sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ agna ye a dī bya a dī bya ā bi sha ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/ me lha 'khor dang bcas pa byon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs bdun 'bul/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs thams cad oṃ suṃ bha ni'i sngags dang yungs kar brab pas bskrad/ de nas/ bskyed pa'i me lhar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod ma thag tu spyan drangs pa'i me lha bskyed pa'i me lha la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ sngar spyan 'dren gyi rgya'am ba dan gsum pa'i rgya bstan la/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten la/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa la dzwa la ya sarba bhasmiṃ ku ru sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ shya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis dam la bzhag /de nas me lha'i sngags mthar chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo btags pas gong ltar mchod la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg |'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces bstod/ de nas lag g.yon byang chub mchog gi rgya kha gyen du blta bas dgang gzar mar gyis bkang ba bzung ba'i steng du/ g.yas de lta bu kha 'og tu blta bas blugs gzar mar gyis bkang ba steng du phyogs pa bzung la/ dgang blugs kyi khar dkyil 'khor pa'i rtsa sngags dang me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags la raṃ yig gis mtshan par phul bas gsol bar gyur par dmigs la sngags ring gi mthar/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ oṃ agna ye bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon bar gcod thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes lan bdun 'bul/ me pra brtags la ngan na las sngags brjod cing bsang chu 'thor/ lha sngags kyi mthar/ ba gegs thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ btags pa bdun 'bul/ bzang na mi dgos/ de nas sreg rdzas rnams las sngags dang bum chus bsangs la/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhes bkru bar bsam/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ yam shing dang*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ zhun mar dang*/ oṃ dzrīṃ swā hā/ 'bru rnams dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes rdzas lhag ma rnams byin gyis brlabs la/ rdzas rnams kyi nyes skyon dag nas ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ de nas g.yon dril bu dang bcas rdzas snod bzung*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb srin gyis rdzas bzung ba'am/ yang na pad kor sngon du 'gro bas g.yon pa'i sor mo lnga dgang gzar dang*/ g.yas pa'i gsum blugs gzar gyi rgyas bskor zhing dbul ba thabs shes mnyam rol gyi rgya ste de gnyis gang bdes/ yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos la zung du sbyar ba 'bul zhing*/ oṃ agna ye oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes dang*/ mar khu blugs gzar gyis dbul zhing*/ oṃ agna ye bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā// til la/ oṃ agna ye oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par sdig pa'i gnyen po phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ yungs kar la/ oṃ agna ye oṃ sarba artha sā dha ya bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*// khyad par bgegs kyi gnyen po phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zas mchog la/

oṃ agna ye oṃ sarba sampa de bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par shes rab dang bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ku sha la/ oṃ agna ye oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par bsrung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dūrba ba la/ oṃ agna ye oṃ badzra ā yuḥṣe bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par tshe phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nas la/ oṃ agna ye oṃ ma hā be gā ya bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gro la/ oṃ agna ye oṃ badzra ghasma ri bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ 'bras la/ oṃ agna ye oṃ badzra puṣṭa ya bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sran ma la/ oṃ agna ye oṃ ma hā ba lā ya bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par lus kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ so ba la/ oṃ agna ye oṃ badzra bi dzā ya bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ shing tog sna tshogs la/ oṃ agna ye oṃ ga ga ni ga ga ni bi lo ki te bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rnams dang*/ khyad par rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes 'bul zhing*/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes chu gsum nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ tshangs dbang mgon sras drang srong lha// phrin las mnga' bdag rdzu 'phrul can// bsreg bya za ba agni'i sku| |mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal bstod// ra skyes steng na rab brjid cing*// mi 'jigs sbyin dang bgrang phreng g.yas// g.yon pa rwa dbyig spyi blugs 'chang*// drang srong chas 'dzin khyod la bstod// rigs sngags rgyal po dge ba po// rab dga' la sogs 'khor bcas la// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i rdzas// sreg blugs zhal zas 'bul gyis bzhes// khyod kyi nus pa'i mthu stobs kyis// 'dod pa'i don rnams grub par mdzod// ces bstod/ gnyis pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bhrūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang zhes pa nas/ bsnyen pa'i bar gyi dkyil 'dir mkha' 'gro thams cad sku mdog dkar po la phyag mtshan gzhung ltar ram g.yas thams cad rdo rje| g.yon thams cad shel gyi bum pa gang bde bya/ sku mdog thams cad nges par dkar por bsgyur dgos so// mchan/ chog ltar las mchod pa'i skabs mchod yon gyi rjes su zhal bsil sngags rgya dang bcas pa bcug gzhan thams cad 'gre/ bsnyen mtshams su bsnyen pa stong phrag sogs ci 'grub bya ba shin tu gal che'o// de nas/ lha rnams kyi ljags lha rang gi mdog can rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i sbu gu can la raṃ dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hūm̐ yig dkar pos mtshan par gyur par dmigs la/ bsnyen sngags kyis dgang blugs bdun phul bas phrin las gang bcol mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes par gyur par bsams la/ long skabs yod na zhi khro so sor 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa na oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sogs me lha'i skabs ltar sbyar ba shing thog gi bar brgya stong sogs dang*/

de bzhin du mi bskyod pa la/ oṃ badzra akṣo bhyaḥ rin 'byung la/ oṃ badzra ratna saṃ bha wā ya/ 'od dpag med la/ oṃ badzra a mi tā bhā ya/ don grub la/ oṃ badzra a mo gha siddha ya/ zhes mtshan sngags mthar rdzas sngags spel tshig sbyar ba gtso bo las nyung tsam dang*/ buddha khro bo la/ oṃ badzra buddha kro dha kro dhī ye/ rnam snang las nyung tsam rigs bzhi las mang tsam 'bul/ rigs bzhi po de las nyung tsam 'bul lo// oṃ badzra ga ya kro dha kro dhī ye/ rin chen khro bo la/ oṃ badzra ratna kro dha kro dhī ye/ padma khro bo la/ oṃ badzra padma kro dha kro dhī ye/ las kyi khro bo la/ oṃ badzra karma kro dha kro dhī ye/ zhes pa'i mthar rdzas sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa/ skabs ye med na/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥpañtsa ma hā kro dha ya oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya/ zhes sbyar bas zhi khro gtso 'khor spoms nas 'bul/ rdzas phul nas phrin las bcol ba'i tshe/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pas bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas rang nyid zla ba la gnas pa la khrus byas pas/ nyes ltung nad gdon thams cad dag nas lus shel ltar gyur par bsam/ de nas las sngags kyis dgang blugs bdun phul/ me tog gi char phab/ slar chu gsum phul nas| oṃ badzra tambu lā ya swā hā/ so rtsi dang*/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar sogs kyis gos zung dang*/ gtor mar sman raka bran la/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin brlabs te/ oṃ pañtsa shanta de wa ma hā kro dha sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis gtor ma 'bul/ mchod bstod rgyas pa mdun bskyed ltar byas la/ 'dod gsol ni/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag sogs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi zhing*/

spangs rtogs kyi yon tan tshe dpal 'byor pa thams cad rab tu 'phel te/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsum brjod/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// zhes sogs dang*/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang*/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ces sho lo ka dang*/ oṃ badzra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gar thim par gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa mjug ni/ las sngags kyis thab dang rdzas rnams bsangs/ me lha'i sngags thung gis sreg blugs gcig phul te/ me lha sku mdog phyag mtshan dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur par dmigs/ sngags sngar ltar mchod cing bstod la/ yam shing nas shing thog gi bar sngar me lha'i skabs ltar lan gsum re dbul bar bya/ slar chu gsum gyis mchod cing*/ tambu las so rtsi dang*/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// sogs kyis gos zung phul/ me lha'i sngags ring dgang blugs bdun dang*/ dkyil 'khor sngags kyis dgang blugs gcig phul bas/ me lha gzi brjid ches cher 'bar bar gyur par bsam/ gtor ma a kā ros byin brlabs nas/ me lha'i sngags thung la a kā ro btags pas phul nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod kyi bar 'dod gsol bya/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ gang yang bdag blo dang*/ yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub mdzad bsreg bya za ba gshegs// ji lta'i dus su slar byon la// bdag gi don kun thams cad sgrubs// badzra muḥ me lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur par bsam/ bsngo smon dang shis brjod bya/ long yod na me rang shir btang*/ med na dri bzang gi chus gzhil/

thal sol bum par blugs la rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor zhing chu de nas bum pa gang khyer te gnas khang la gtor/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/// / ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa phung po sbyang ba'i lhan thabs ni/ sngar bshad pa'i sa stegs kyi steng du dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus kyang gang zag mchog la sgo rdzogs dang*/ phal pa la lha gnas bris pa'i steng du shing khang ni mchog la/ khru gang gru bzhi pa stegs bu/ seng khri/ ba gam dang bad chen/ rmang dge/ bang rim/ bum gdan man chad tshul dang mthun pa/ phal pa la gru bzhi pa kha khyer can/ de dag gang la'ang nang du bud shing dang*/ ka ba/ rdo mchu/ me tshang*/ rlung sgo sogs mthong brgyud ltar bya/ de nas pur khang ni rab byung la mchod rten gyi dbyibs dkar po/ dge bsnyen la padma dmar po kha sbyar ba'i dbyibs/ rgyal po la sngon po gtsug tor lta bu/ blon po la dmar skya za ma tog lta bu/ tha mal pa pho la ser po gdan khri lta bu/ mo la sngo skya bil 'bras lta bu/ byis pa la dmar ser lhung bzed lta bu/ rang dang chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma la bum pa/ bre| chos 'khor/ gdugs sogs mchod rten lta bu de rnams kyang gang byed kyang ro bcug zin nas phyi nas thag pas bsdams shing 'jim pas zhal ba byas la dkar rtsi byug go// ro'i lte ba'i thad du me tshang dang*/ snying kha'i thad du rdzas dbul ba'i bug pa gzhag /dmu chu can gyi chu dbyung ba dang*/ tshon po'i zhun dbyung ba dang*/ rgas 'khogs tshig dka' ba la rdzas gsum gyi sbyor ba dang*/ dar ma dgun shi ba'i rgyus pa dral ba dang*/ dug gis shi ba'i ro la bya ba dang*/ za 'dre sbub gzhug sogs man ngag ltar bya'o// mchog gi pur khang gi zur bzhir rgyal mtshan dang*/ logs rnams su ba dan/ rtse mor gdugs dang mtha' skor du mchod pa'i yo byad rnams mdzes par bya'o// de nas ro chas su gzhug cing bsreg pa la gnyis/ phal pa'i ro mchod rdzas kyi tshul du sreg pa dang*/

mchog gi gdung mchod gnas kyi tshul du sbyang tshul lo// dang po ni/ dri bzang dang las thams cad pa'i chus bkru/ ras sam snam dkar gyis phyis pa'i spyi bor rnam snang*/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ltag g.yas su rin 'byung*/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ltag g.yon du don grub/ snying ga'i dbus su buddha khro bo/ mdun du rdo rje khro bo/ g.yas sam lhor ratna khro bo/ rgyab bam nub tu padma khro bo/ byang ngam g.yon du las kyi khro bo yab yum rnams kyi sngags gos dar ram rgya shog la/ gser dngul lam/ mtshal lam/ dri bzang gis landza'am wartula'i gzugs kyis bri/ tsog pu rkang bshibs lag pa thab 'gel mgo cung zad sgur ba la rab byung yin na las sngags bzlas pa'i chos gos dang*/ khyim par las sngags bzlas pa'i gos dmar g.yogs la rgyan dang bcas thab khung du gzhug /'di rnams mi sreg kyang ri chu dur khrod sogs su skyel bar yang byas na shis so// ro thab khung du ma bcug gong lho sgo byas na legs so| |cho ga dngos ni bshad ma thag pa ltar las me sbar dus/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu// nas/ 'gro ba'i don du grub par shog /bar gyis sbar/ yam shing 'bul ba'i sngon der/ me lha rdo rje las kyi gtso// tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyong ba dang*// lha rnams tshim par bya ba'i phyir// 'di nyid du ni phrin las mdzod// ces bskul bas me lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ tshe las 'das pa'i rnam shes dang sdig sgrib bkug ste rnam shes rang gi mdun du kha dkyil 'khor pa la phyogs te 'khod cing sdig sgrib rnams sreg rdzas dang ro la thim par gyur/ ces mos/ spel tshig ni yam shing lta bu la sngags mjug tu/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung*/ sa lam dang spangs rtogs kyi bar gcod/ sdug bsngal gyi tshogs dang*/ khyad par gzi brjid sogs dkyus ltar bya/ 'das pa'i lha bskyed pa'i sngon du/

drang srong chen po me lha yis// sngon gyi dam bcas mna' bor ba// lha rnams zhal ni me yin te// sbyin sreg de ni me la gnas// zhes gsol ba btab cing 'das lha bskyed/ yam shing 'bul ba'i sngon du/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra zhes pa nas/ he tu hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar brab sngags tshar gsum brjod nas/ rdzas rnams rim gyis 'bul zhing 'dod gsol bshad ma thag pa ltar bya/ rdzas phul nas phrin las bcol ba'i tshe/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas tshe 'das kyi rnam shes snga ma'i lus ltar gnas pa la phog sgrib pa sbyangs/ slar 'od kyi sne la dbang gi lha bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa spros/ tshe 'das kyi spyi bo nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ de'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs te de nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par byas/ oṃ badzra rakṣa hūm̐/ zhes bsrung*/ de nas/ kye/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu// rigs drug gnas na bde ba med// ces pa nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis reg ma thag tu bde ba can gyi zhing mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa'i thugs kar thim pas de'i thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur gyi bar byas la lam bstan/ skabs 'dir spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rgyang gis thon nas zhes pa dor ro// de man chad sreg chog dkyus bshad ma thag pa kho na ltar byas pas grub la/ me shi nas rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ oṃ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rus bu bsdus la sātstsha'i cho ga bya/ thal sol ni chu bor dor ba kho na legs so// tshul 'di ni 'ga' zhig slob dpon du rlom pas gzhan gyi ro sreg pa'i cho ga'i rnam dbye med par bza' ba'i ched du dud 'gro'i sha sreg pa ltar bya ba mthong bas tshul de lta bu las ches cher 'phags so// gnyis pa mchog gi gdung mchod gnas kyi tshul du bsreg pa ni/

khrus gsol gnas yig sogs gong ltar las phyag gnyis rdor dril dang bcas thugs kar bsnol/ zhabs sogs sngar ltar bya/ za 'dre sbub gzhug sogs mi dgos/ de nas pur la dbu rgyan na bza' dang bcas pa'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams la/ bdag bum dkyus ltar bya zhing sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na mdun bskyed mi dgos| |pur bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'khor lo'i dbang phyug sogs su bskyed/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar byas nas/ pur lhar gsal ba rol mo spos dang bcas spyan drangs la thab tu gzhug /pur lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar gang zag de rang gi lhag pa'i lha bskyed la mchod bstod bzlas pa bya/ bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol/ de ltar ma byas par bzhu na nye ba'i mtshams med du 'gyur ro// tshul 'di ni sngar nas rim gnyis la goms pa la'ang lhag par shis so// de nas me sbar ba'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis sbar bar bsam la/ chos 'brel med pa'i mi zhig gis zhabs tog gi tshul du sbar/ gson cig dgongs shig gi mal du/ dpal ldan bla ma dgongs su gsol// zhes sbyar/ sreg rdzas rnams mchod rdzas su 'bul/ sdig sgrib dang dbyer med mi bya/ me lha rdo rje sogs dang lam bstan sbyang mi dgos/ rdzas phul nas phrin bcol dbang bskur yang dor/ spel tshig rang dang chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gang na bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi bar du gcod pa rnams dang*/ khyad par gzi brjid sogs/ chos 'brel med pa la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa zhes dang*/ dge slong tshad ldan la/ sdom brtson ldan pa zhes dang*/ gsang sngags 'chang ba rang dang chos 'brel yod pa la/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes dang*/ chos 'brel med na/ rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes dang*/ rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa la/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa zhes dang*/

bla mar btags tsam sogs spyi khyab la/ yongs 'dzin dam pa tsam sbyar/ pur sbyang zin nas dri bzang gi chus me gzhil/ steng gi bug pa rdo rje rgya gram dang logs kyi bug pa gnyis rdo rje rkyang pa re re sgo bzhir rgyal chen bzhi'i gzugs dang bcas pas bsdams la zhag bdun sogs mchod pa dang khrus gsol bya/ de nas pur khang phye nas gdung rus rnams rten bzhengs su gsol zhing thal sol sa rdo rnams lam gyi bzhi mdo sogs su mchod rten bya'o// tshul 'di ni gang zag mchog yin nges la bya yi/ phal pa longs spyod 'khor 'bangs dang snyan grags tsam la brten nas dam pa mchog tu rlom pa la ni 'di las sbyong tshul snga ma gnyis rnam smin la phan par sems so/ /deng sang gang zag phal pa la blun dad kyis mchog gi bya ba byed pa ni sgrib pa'i gnyen po yang sgrib pa nyid du 'gyur ro// sngags gzhung chu gter 'jings dbang dpag dka' ba// blo gros ri dbang gar gyis bsrubs pa las/ /sgrib sbyong rta bdun khri la 'jo sgeg mkhan/ /legs bshad sngon med nor bu 'di min nam/ /dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ rgyal ba zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi zhi ba'i spyin sreg gi cho ga lhan thabs dang bcas pa 'di'ang rang gzhan kun la phan pa'i blos/ gsang ba sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa padma badzra rtsal zhes sam/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas gzhu spro lung du sbyar ba ste 'di dag gi mtha' dpyod rgyas pa ni kho bos byas pa'i gtsug tor dgu'i sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye ma'i nang du yang rtogs par byos shig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
